visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a woman featuring short dark hair, wearing a white top and a black open jacket, standing at the entrance of a Japanese restaurant. She smiles broadly and gives a peace sign while sliding out from behind a beige noren curtain decorated with black calligraphy. The exterior setting is brightly lit by indoor-style hallway lights, showing signs and informational posters on the wall. (2) A fast-paced montage follows, displaying a mobile screen with Google ratings (4.3 stars) and professional-looking food photography. Close-up shots feature a plate of grilled beef tongue slices alongside pickled vegetables and a small bowl of soup. The woman is then seen inside the restaurant, gesturing toward a physical menu that showcases various meat platters under warm, soft indoor lighting. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor urban environment at night, capturing a tall building illuminated by several bright neon signs for brands like KFC and Big Echo. In a narrow hallway outside the restaurant, a dense crowd of people in casual attire is seen waiting in line. A close-up shot shows a hand holding a small white queue ticket with the number 243 printed on it. (4) Back inside the restaurant, the woman is sitting at a wooden table, using chopsticks to lift a thick piece of succulent grilled beef tongue to her mouth. She chews with a satisfied expression. Detailed shots show white grated yam being poured from a ceramic bowl onto a bed of rice, and two white, oval-shaped fish cakes (kamaboko) grilling over a small, glowing charcoal brazier. (5) The final sequence features a close-up of a paper receipt showing a total bill of 10,736 yen. The woman gives a thumbs-up to the camera while sitting in the booth. The video concludes with a shot of the restaurant's lit-up sign 'Zenjirou' and a view of the persistent crowd still waiting in the corridor late at night under artificial lighting.
